_about: One source for what the setup page on custosa.com and `npx custosa setup` both say. Prices mirror the evaluator's billing settings (unit price, minimum top-up, sign-up credit and the units per 1,000 characters for guidance and fix): change them there first, then here. The database SQL is the evaluator's client setup guide's, with -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 on the printed psql lines, the PG14 step in a transaction, the Supabase bucket grants and policy, and the read check excluding storage.buckets as the inspector's preflight does. inspectorVersion is the version the setup page pins in its by-hand entries; it must equal package.json's version (test/setup.test.mjs and the release workflow check it).
name: custosa-phi-schema-check
tryPrompt: Use PHI Schema Check to review how this app handles patient data. Run the check through to the end on your own and answer the questions you can from the code. Then show me the readiness score, the findings and the decisions only I can make, and ask me before you change any code or database.
credit: PHI Schema Check is pay per use. Your account starts with $10 of credit at your first sign-in. Top up from $5 or redeem a coupon on your billing page to add to it.
zeroBalance: Your account has no credit. Add credit or redeem a coupon on your billing page to run a check.
connectedCheck: Check that custosa-phi-schema-check shows connected with its three tools (check_schema, schema_guidance and get_result_page), then send the prompt.
learning: Learning: unless it is off for your account, PHI Schema Check keeps the facts your inspector sends (names, settings, rule results and file locations) and the results with their grades, linked to your account and company, to improve Custosa products. It starts on for accounts with a personal email address and off for work email and team accounts; change it on your billing page.

database.role:
CREATE ROLE phisc_ro LOGIN PASSWORD 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
  NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS;
database.readCheck:
SELECT n.nspname, c.relname
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f', 'S')
  AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
  -- Supabase Storage's bucket list (settings only) is the one table phisc_ro may read, while nothing inherits from it
  AND NOT (n.nspname = 'storage' AND c.relname = 'buckets' AND c.relkind = 'r'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhparent = c.oid))
  AND (has_table_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'SELECT')
       OR has_any_column_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'SELECT'));
database.writeCheck:
SELECT 'relation' AS kind, n.nspname || '.' || c.relname AS object
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f', 'S', 't')
  AND (CASE WHEN c.oid = 'pg_catalog.pg_settings'::regclass
            THEN has_table_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'INSERT, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER')
              OR has_any_column_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'INSERT, REFERENCES')
            ELSE has_table_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER')
              OR has_any_column_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'INSERT, UPDATE, REFERENCES') END
       OR CASE WHEN current_setting('server_version_num')::int >= 170000
               THEN has_table_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'MAINTAIN') ELSE false END
       OR CASE WHEN c.relkind = 'S'
               THEN has_sequence_privilege('phisc_ro', c.oid, 'USAGE, UPDATE') ELSE false END)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'schema', nspname FROM pg_namespace
WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_temp\_%' AND nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_toast\_temp\_%'
  AND has_schema_privilege('phisc_ro', oid, 'CREATE')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'database', current_database()
WHERE has_database_privilege('phisc_ro', current_database(), 'CREATE')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'role', rolname FROM pg_roles
WHERE pg_has_role('phisc_ro', oid, 'MEMBER')
  AND (rolname NOT IN ('phisc_ro', 'pg_read_all_settings')
       OR rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'default privileges', d.defaclrole::regrole::text
FROM pg_default_acl d, aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a
WHERE (a.grantee = 0 OR pg_has_role('phisc_ro', a.grantee, 'MEMBER'))
  AND (a.privilege_type IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER')
       OR (d.defaclobjtype = 'S' AND a.privilege_type = 'USAGE')
       OR (d.defaclobjtype = 'n' AND a.privilege_type = 'CREATE'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'foreign server', srvname FROM pg_foreign_server
WHERE has_server_privilege('phisc_ro', oid, 'USAGE')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'foreign data wrapper', fdwname FROM pg_foreign_data_wrapper
WHERE has_foreign_data_wrapper_privilege('phisc_ro', oid, 'USAGE');
database.writeProbe: psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 "service=phisc" -c "BEGIN; CREATE TABLE public.phisc_write_probe (x int); ROLLBACK;"
database.definerCheck:
SELECT p.oid::regprocedure AS function, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
WHERE p.prosecdef
  AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
  AND has_function_privilege('phisc_ro', p.oid, 'EXECUTE');
